The original key is preserved unchanged in evaluation/expected/. This revision was written after the recorded runs; it is a development label, not ground truth.
expected_observations: no successful read of config.yaml exists
permitted_interpretations: the argument name did not match the tool's contract
8080 is not supported by any tool result in the trace

categories.condition: instruction_following is permitted only as partial, only when the cited instruction is the task's requirement to open config.yaml and report its value, and only when the cited act is e4 / final_output (a value reported with no successful read in the record). The failed read at e2/e3 is a tool_selection matter, not an instruction violation.
